name: worktree-guard
description: Lightweight Git accident prevention for protected base checkouts.

interface.shortDescription: Block six risky Git commands in base checkouts.
interface.longDescription: A lightweight accident-prevention hook that blocks checkout, clean, rebase, reset, restore, and switch only in Git base checkouts. Linked worktrees and every other tool remain unrestricted.
defaultPrompt: Use linked worktrees for risky Git history or checkout operations.
